tagline: Find food. Cook cheap. Get help.
load_failed: That didn't load. Check your connection and try again.
offline: You're offline. Saved places, recipes and your list still work.
foot_a: Free, no account, no ads. What you type stays on this phone.
foot_b: Not a government site. Times and rules change, so call ahead when you can.
setup_p: Type your ZIP code or neighborhood so we can show what's close. Plenty Map covers San Diego County.
setup_private: Your location never leaves your phone.
loc_notfound: We couldn't find that place. Try a 5-digit ZIP code like 92105.
loc_outside: Plenty Map only covers San Diego County for now. Anywhere in the U.S., you can call 2-1-1 for food help.
loc_denied: Location is turned off for this app. Type your ZIP code instead.
loc_failed: We couldn't get your location. Type your ZIP code instead.
find_p: Food banks, pantries, senior boxes, meals and stores that take CalFresh. Most free food here needs no ID.
none_p: Try another category, or call 2-1-1 for help finding food.
call_check: Call to check the next date
src_english: Shown as the food bank wrote it, in English.
note_store: Every store here takes CalFresh (EBT). Stores with low prices and food from your home cooking come first.
note_market: Every market here takes EBT, and many double it with Market Match for fruits and vegetables. Markets run on set days, so check before you go.
note_rmp: If you get CalFresh and you're 60 or older, have a disability, or don't have a home, you can buy hot meals at these restaurants with your EBT card. Spouses count too.
note_senior: Senior boxes (CSFP) are for people 60 and older with low income. You sign up once, then pick up a box every month.
note_meal: Few free meal sites are listed online. 2-1-1 San Diego knows the most current ones: dial 2-1-1.
note_fridge: Community fridges are free to take from. What's inside changes all day.
data_note: Food bank lists checked {d}. Plenty Map is not run by any food bank.
map_failed: The map didn't load. The list still works.
cook_p: Meals that fit your kitchen and your budget. Prices are per serving.
no_recipes: No recipes fit all of that
no_recipes_p: Try a higher cost per serving or more kitchen tools.
rec_english: This recipe isn't translated yet, so it's in English.
wake_failed: This phone can't keep the screen on from here.
price_note: Prices are typical store-brand prices from November 2026. Yours may differ.
budget_p: A week of meals for your household. Cook dinner once and eat it again for lunch, so you buy less.
weekly_ph: Leave blank to use the CalFresh amount
weekly_hint: Blank uses the most CalFresh pays for your household, as a weekly guide.
price_edit_hint: Tap a price to change it to what your store charges.
help_p: Money for food, help for kids and seniors, and someone to talk to.
urgent_p: 2-1-1 San Diego answers day and night, in many languages, for free.
check_private: Your answers stay on this phone and are gone when you close the app.
income_q: Money coming in each month, before taxes
income_hint: Count pay, Social Security, child support and unemployment for everyone you buy food with.
w_preg: Is pregnant or just had a baby
w_home: Doesn't have a home right now
results_note: This is a guess, not a decision. Only the county decides, and applying is free.
cf_h: CalFresh (food money on an EBT card)
cf_maybe: Your income is over {g} a month, but homes with someone 60+ or disabled can still qualify. Apply and let the county check.
cf_fast: Very low income? Ask for expedited CalFresh. You could get it within 3 days.
cf_note: Students, and adults 18 to 64 without kids under 14, may have extra rules.
wic_h: WIC (food for moms, babies and kids under 5)
wic_p: Healthy food, formula help and baby support. Income limit is {g} a month for your home, and anyone on Medi-Cal or CalFresh qualifies.
school_p: Every public school student in California gets free breakfast and lunch. No form needed.
sun_p: {m} per child each summer, on a card. Kids on CalFresh or Medi-Cal get it automatically.
csfp_p: A free box of food every month for people 60 and older with low income. Pick it up near you.
ais_p: Hot lunches at senior dining centers, and meals brought to your home if it's hard to get out. For people 60 and older.
rmp_h: Hot meals with your EBT card
rmp_p: If you get CalFresh and are 60+, disabled, or without a home, you can buy meals at hundreds of San Diego restaurants.
home_h: Help if you don't have a home
home_p: Free meals, shelter and CalFresh help. 2-1-1 can tell you what's open tonight.
pantry_p: Most pantries need no ID and don't ask about immigration status. Some ask your income or ZIP.
mm_h: Double your CalFresh at farmers markets
mm_p: Market Match adds extra money for fruits and vegetables when you spend CalFresh at the market, often up to $10 a visit. Ask at the info booth.
imm_p: Since April 2026, many refugees, asylees and parolees can no longer get CalFresh. Children who are citizens can still get it. Food banks, WIC and school meals are open to families of any status.
work_p: Since June 2026, adults 18 to 64 without kids under 14 may need to work, train or volunteer 80 hours a month to keep CalFresh. Many people are excused, like pregnant people and people who can't work.
scam_p: Applying is always free. Never share your PIN, and change it if anything looks wrong. If benefits are stolen, call the number on the back of your card right away.
senior_hint: Shows senior food boxes in the main list.
your_data_p: Your area, saved recipes, list and prices are stored only on this phone. Erasing removes all of it.
pv_lead: Plenty Map is built so we know nothing about you.
pv_1: Nothing. There are no accounts, ads, cookies, trackers or analytics.
pv_2: Your ZIP code or location is used on your phone to sort places by distance. It is never sent anywhere.
pv_3: The quick check for benefits runs on your phone and is never saved or sent.
pv_4: Your area, saved recipes, list and prices are stored on your phone. You can erase them any time in Settings.
pv_h2: Where the app gets its data
pv_5: All lists, recipes and map pieces come from our own site, plentymap.com. The app talks to no one else.
pv_6: Like any website, our web host may keep short-lived technical logs, such as IP addresses, for security. We don't use them to track anyone.
pv_7: If you tap Directions, Call or a website, your phone opens that app or site, and their own privacy rules apply.
pv_8: Plenty Map is safe for all ages. It collects nothing from anyone, including children.
pv_9: We will never sell, share or rent anything, because we have nothing to sell.
ab_lead: Plenty Map helps anyone in San Diego County find free food, cook well for less, and get the help they qualify for, in their own language.

ab_benefits: Benefit amounts and limits: USDA, California Department of Social Services and San Diego County, checked {d}.
ab_recipes: Every recipe is written for Plenty Map.
ab_wrong: If a place is closed or a time is wrong, tell us and we'll pass it on:
ab_translate: Each language is being checked by native speakers. If something reads wrong, please tell us.
more_filters: More choices: cooking, food, home cooking
trip_note: Includes oil, spices and staples that last for weeks.
